description: This file contains test cases for the sanitization functions and system prompt builder used in an OpenCLaw project. It verifies the correct removal of control and Unicode formatting characters from strings and the proper construction of sanitized prompts, specifically testing functions like sanitizeForPromptLiteral, buildAgentSystemPrompt, and wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock.

methods.name: sanitizeForPromptLiteral
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by removing ASCII control characters, Unicode line/paragraph separators, and format characters.

methods.name: buildAgentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a system prompt string incorporating sanitized workspace and sandbox information.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock
methods.description: Wraps sanitized text inside a special untrusted data block with proper tags.
